notes: The Talk (NP_10 s4): the corner's fifth action - Whitlock's dialogue with the NEXT fighter, three options keyed to that fighter's personality (NP_11 s9 Fighter.personality.talk_profile, carried on the card as 'talk'). Every talk offers the same three approaches, each in the fighter's own line: the plan, the fire, the arm around the shoulder. The one the card names lands: +5% all stats for that fighter's segment, bound to that fighter (a swap after the talk leaves it unheard). A wrong read gives nothing and costs only the action (NP_10 s4: never a penalty for trying to know your kids). One talk per corner; a card with no profile cannot be read. Bond levels reveal which talk lands: the next fighter's best Kizuna with a dressed teammate - Gymmates (Lv1) rules one wrong option out, Corner Voices (Lv2) and above names the right one - the teammate is the one who tells you. The profiles live on the cards (core.gd's Millbrook cards: RORY fire, PRIYA plan, MARCUS arm, JUNE fire, SAM arm, DEX arm, YURI fire, MARTA plan); Priya's is the doc's (NP_12A s5: she wants the projection confirmed, never comfort); the other seven and all 24 lines are first drafts from the cards' scenes (NP_12A s3, NP_12, NP_04 s8.3, NP_04A) pending the content lane.

RORY.plan: Two to the body, then take the centre and keep it.
RORY.fire: Nobody from this gym stays down. Go show them.
RORY.arm: Whatever happens out there, the gym's open Monday.

PRIYA.plan: Your projection holds. Third exchange, he leads right.
PRIYA.arm: You don't have to be perfect out there.

MARCUS.plan: Double jab, then the right hand. Nothing else.
MARCUS.fire: Let the temper out. All of it.
MARCUS.arm: We asked for you. The hands and the temper both.

JUNE.plan: Stay in the centre and count your exchanges.
JUNE.fire: He thinks you're too small. Go again until he's sure.
JUNE.arm: Take a breath first. There's no hurry.

SAM.plan: Walk him down. Let the wall take the first minute.
SAM.fire: No sorry this time. Just hit him.
SAM.arm: Take your time. You're the last door they have to get through.

DEX.plan: Pull him in and counter off the clinch.
DEX.fire: Show them what the boats taught you.
DEX.arm: Your cousin's watching. So is this gym. Both of them are glad you're here.

YURI.plan: Coupling first, then Freight. Keep it on the rails.
YURI.fire: Load it up. The whole gym is shouting with you.
YURI.arm: Win or lose, your family's in the second row.

MARTA.plan: He reads your silence. Turn the glove late and make him guess.
MARTA.fire: Make them sorry they let you go.
MARTA.arm: You're one of ours now. That's settled.
